# Comparison and critique

Compare the original task, candidate argument, and independent reconstruction. Give concrete mathematical reasons for objections. Do not invent a fault merely to be critical, and do not infer correctness from agreement.

Audit correctness, fidelity to the original quantifiers and conclusion, and source applicability separately. Treat novelty as unknown without adequate literature evidence. Carry forward every unresolved serious objection. Classify findings as verified within the supplied evidence, conditional, contradicted, or unresolved. No claim becomes accepted because of this report.
